about: #1332 the readers on the finding history: which statements the SQL seams send to the served views. ONE list for both implementations -- engine/_shared/data-sql/SI-FindingSource.ps1 (tests/pester/SIv3-FindingHistoryReaders.Tests.ps1) and SI.Management.Core/ProData/FindingSource.cs (FindingSourceTests). 'want' = the statement after routing; null = unchanged.

cases.sql: SELECT f.Title FROM sidata.Finding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @c
cases.want: SELECT f.Title FROM sidata.vFinding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @c

cases.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sidata.Collection c JOIN sidata.Finding f ON f.CollectionId = c.CollectionId
cases.want: SELECT 1 FROM sidata.Collection c JOIN sidata.vFinding f ON f.CollectionId = c.CollectionId

cases.why: a join hint and a second reference
cases.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sidata.Collection AS col INNER LOOP JOIN sidata.Finding AS f ON f.CollectionId = col.CollectionId WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sidata.Finding AS x WHERE x.FindingId = f.FindingId)
cases.want: SELECT 1 FROM sidata.Collection AS col INNER LOOP JOIN sidata.vFinding AS f ON f.CollectionId = col.CollectionId WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sidata.vFinding AS x WHERE x.FindingId = f.FindingId)

cases.sql: SELECT x.FindingId FROM sidata.vExemptedFinding AS x UNION ALL SELECT y.FindingId FROM sidata.vCurrentFinding y
cases.want: SELECT x.FindingId FROM sidata.vExemptedFindingServed AS x UNION ALL SELECT y.FindingId FROM sidata.vCurrentFindingServed y

cases.why: other tables whose names start the same are not the findings
cases.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sidata.FindingFacet AS ff JOIN sidata.FindingState AS s ON 1 = 1 JOIN sidata.FindingStateMember AS m ON 1 = 1 JOIN sidata.FindingChange AS c ON 1 = 1

cases.why: a quoted name is never a source
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('sidata.Finding') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'sidata.Finding', 'Cve') > 0 THEN 1 END

cases.why: a quoted name beside a read: only the read moves
cases.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('sidata.Finding', 'RaFindingKey') IS NULL RETURN; SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.Finding AS f
cases.want: IF COL_LENGTH('sidata.Finding', 'RaFindingKey') IS NULL RETURN; SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.vFinding AS f

cases.why: a read inside dynamic SQL moves; the quoted name in it does not
cases.sql: DECLARE @own nvarchar(100) = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('sidata.Finding', 'CarriedFrom') IS NOT NULL THEN N' AND f.CarriedFrom IS NULL' ELSE N'' END; DECLARE @q nvarchar(max) = N'SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.Finding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @CollectionId' + @own; EXEC sp_executesql @q
cases.want: DECLARE @own nvarchar(100) = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH('sidata.Finding', 'CarriedFrom') IS NOT NULL THEN N' AND f.CarriedFrom IS NULL' ELSE N'' END; DECLARE @q nvarchar(max) = N'SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.vFinding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @CollectionId' + @own; EXEC sp_executesql @q

SELECT 1 FROM sidata.vFinding AS f

cases.why: a read that fills a work table is a read
cases.sql: INSERT #w (FindingId) SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.Finding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @C
cases.want: INSERT #w (FindingId) SELECT f.FindingId FROM sidata.vFinding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @C

cases.why: a reader that keeps the stored rows (the findings list) is never routed
cases.sql: SELECT TOP (50) f.FindingId FROM sidata.Finding AS f WHERE f.CollectionId = @c ORDER BY f.RiskScore DESC /* si.finding.source: stored */
select f.Title from SIDATA.FINDING as f
cases.want: select f.Title from sidata.vFinding as f
